id="RFC-0003" title="Agent Capability Tokens" status="Draft" inferred=false
author="Donald Gifford" created="2026-05-10"
summary="Introduce a **capability token** model — a controller-signed JWT issued at AgentRun crea…"
problem="The framework and ADK currently have three security mechanisms operating independently: 1.…"
proposal="A controller-issued, Vault-Transit-signed JWT carries the agent's identity, provenance, an…"
alternatives=0 risks=10 criteria=19 open-questions=0 references=14

risk line=599
  risk="Tool author bypasses dispatcher"
  impact="Critical — defeats the model"
  likelihood="Low if framework is the only registration path"
  mitigation="Tools registered only via framework's `RegisterTool`; lint catches in-package shortcuts; code review"

risk line=600
  risk="Signing key compromise"
  impact="Critical — forged tokens"
  likelihood="Low"
  mitigation="Vault Transit + rotation + audit; revoke + cache-flush playbook"

risk line=601
  risk="OPA policy bug grants wrong scope"
  impact="High — unauthorized tool calls"
  likelihood="Medium without rigor"
  mitigation="regal lint, policy test suite (allow + deny branches per rule), required review for `policies/` changes"

risk line=602
  risk="Egress proxy as SPOF"
  impact="Medium — agent network fails"
  likelihood="Low"
  mitigation="Sidecar with restart-on-failure; proxy down → agent's network is down (fail-closed, not bypass)"

risk line=603
  risk="Scope vocabulary churn"
  impact="Medium — registry rot"
  likelihood="High over time"
  mitigation="Treat scopes as a contract; semver; RFC for new ones; deprecation process with grace period"

risk line=604
  risk="Performance overhead at dispatch"
  impact="Low — microseconds"
  likelihood="Low"
  mitigation="Compiled OPA queries cached; benchmark in CI; budget <5ms p99"

risk line=605
  risk="Token theft from compromised sandbox"
  impact="Medium — limited window"
  likelihood="Medium"
  mitigation="Short lifetime (≤ wall-clock budget); `sandbox_instance_id` binding; audience scoping; future: replay-detection via jti tracking"

risk line=606
  risk="Rotation runbook drift"
  impact="Medium — operational mishap"
  likelihood="Medium"
  mitigation="Runbook tested quarterly; key rotation simulation as part of disaster-recovery drills"

risk line=607
  risk="Policy hot-reload requested mid-run"
  impact="Low — operational temptation"
  likelihood="Medium"
  mitigation="Policies are baked into images; the same trust-boundary argument the JWT is solving rules out hot-reload"

risk line=608
  risk="Cross-cluster federation needed"
  impact="Medium — JWT model insufficient"
  likelihood="Low for v1, growing later"
  mitigation="SPIFFE migration path documented in the sibling ADR; v2 work"

  text="100% of tool dispatches in test agents go through the policy gate (verified by dispatcher unit tests + integration test)"

  text="Zero tool calls succeed without a matching scope in chaos testing (deliberately misconfigured agent)"
